sources.entry: Papra - Minimalist document storage, management and archiving platform designed to be simple to use and accessible to everyone. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Papra is a minimalistic, self-hostable document management and archiving platform for long-term storage and retrieval of documents such as receipts and warranties.
summary.what_it_does: Papra lets users upload, store, tag, and search documents, with full-text search and advanced filters. It supports organizations for sharing document collections with family, friends, or colleagues, plus user accounts and authentication. Documents can be imported by emailing or forwarding them to a generated address, by folder ingestion, or through a CLI, and text is extracted from images and scanned documents for search. Tagging rules can automatically tag documents, and custom per-organization properties can store extra information. Documents can be shared externally with optional expiration dates and password protection, and an API, SDK and webhooks are available for building other applications.
use_cases: share documents with family or colleagues
automatically import scanned documents from email or a folder
how_to_run: Generate a real AUTH_SECRET for production with: openssl rand -hex 48
Refer to the self-hosting documentation for further configuration options
notable: Email ingestion: forward emails to a generated address to import documents automatically
Document sharing with optional expiration dates and password protection
Per-organization custom properties and tagging rules
CLI, API, SDK and webhooks for building on top of the platform
Live demo runs client-side only with local storage and no backend
caveats: Mobile app, desktop app, browser extension and AI features are listed as future ideas, not available yet
Document requests feature is marked as coming soon
The README's quick-start AUTH_SECRET is for testing only and must be replaced for real use
